results.title: Flaw-first hauls outperform polished try-ons
results.snippet: Secondhand creators who open on the damage — stains, pilling, missing buttons — are seeing markedly higher saves than those who cut straight to the styled fit. Audiences read hidden condition as a sales tactic.

results.title: Resale apps push local drops, restock content peaks
results.snippet: Marketplace pushes for scheduled local drops have made 'restock' a repeatable weekly format. Creators who name what did not sell report higher trust and steadier follower growth.

results.title: Vintage stores are invisible on short-form
results.snippet: A sweep of Singapore vintage stores found most run an Instagram of flat-lay stills and post no fitting-room video. Stores with strong curation and no video are the clearest creator-partnership gap in resale.

results.title: Garment care services have no creator content
results.snippet: Specialist cleaning and repair services report most enquiries come from secondhand buyers, yet almost none work with creators. Stain-removal demonstrations are among the most requested formats in resale comments.

results.title: Audiences punish invented resale valuations
results.snippet: Comment analysis on flip content shows sharp negative sentiment when creators quote resale prices they never achieved. Videos that show the actual sold listing outperform on saves and comments.

results.title: Organisation content loses to flips on retention
results.snippet: Across the secondhand category, wardrobe organisation and folding content retains roughly a third as well as flip and restock content. Creators report it rarely converts to follows or sales.
